title: La Barceloneta · Platja de Sant Miquel
description: The beach of the L4 (docs/places/barceloneta.md): the Passeig Marítim with its palms, lamp masts and white parapet over the timber boardwalk, L'Estel Ferit's four rusted cubes on the sand, the sea with its lines of white water and the swash running up the wet sand, the lifeguard post, the old lookout mast, the volleyball nets, the beach bar's loungers, the old Barceloneta's blocks with washing on the balconies, the L4 entrance at the inland edge, the breakwater at the east end, the overview with the W's sail, and a greyscale check that Gerard stands out on the sand.

steps.caption: Up from the L4 on the Passeig Marítim: palms, lamp masts, the white parapet over the boardwalk and the cubes on the sand
L'Estel Ferit: four rusted cubes stacked off true on their base, the rope round them, a volleyball net beside
The shore: lines of white water rolling in, the swash running up the wet sand
Three seconds later: the wave has slid back and the next one is coming
The lifeguard post, off duty in October, and someone's towels
The beach bar at the west end: loungers in pairs under blue-and-white parasols
The old lookout mast from 1992 leaning over the sand, the volleyball courts behind
The old Barceloneta's block ends on the promenade: restaurants below, washing on every balcony
By the parapet, a sand cat asleep and its sculptor's cap
Up from the L4 at the inland edge, in a narrow street of the old Barceloneta (the real station is round the corner, at Pla de Palau); the cut opens the block in front
The west end of the beach, by the water: the swash on the wet sand and the yellow buoys of the bathing area
The east end: the breakwater's arm comes ashore past the edge, the sand widening behind it
Overview: the sea along the near side with the sun glittering on it, the beach, the promenade's palms and the old Barceloneta's blocks; the W's sail beyond the west end
Greyscale check: Gerard in navy reads at once on the pale sand
